decide.name: Decide
decide.description: Answers yes/no (noul), choice and score questions about a prompt and/or entity states with an Ollama System One decision model.

attachments.name: Attachments
attachments.description: Images (PNG, JPEG or WebP) shared by all questions. Requires a vision decision model such as clef.

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Entities whose current state and attributes are included in the state the questions are asked about.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.description: Text describing the state the questions are about. When entities are also given, this is included as `context`.

questions.name: Questions
questions.description: List of questions. Each has a type (noul, choice or score), instructions, criteria (choice: option to description map; score: list from lowest to highest; noul: optional true/false descriptions) and an optional name used as the answer key.
